sources: ESPN gamelog + match summary API (primary, per-match data)
notes: Goals excluding friendlies = 59 Barcelona + 11 Spain = 70, matching Wikipedia career totals; the 2 extra goals (vs Como, Joan Gamper Trophy 2025-08-10) are a friendly.

2025-01-15 Copa del Rey vs Real Betis: ESPN counts 2 assists but its match text only names 1 (Koundé 27'); the second is not identified, so total assists here (68) is 1 lower than ESPN's stat total (69).
Minutes are as recorded by ESPN, e.g. 45'+2' = stoppage time. match_score is written home-first.
FBref/Transfermarkt/Sofascore could not be fetched (403/405/timeout), so assist counts are cross-checked only against Wikipedia/club figures where available.
